verdict.rationale: Parsec for Teams documents audit logs, with full audit logs available via the Teams API and a 7-day audit log on a lower tier. The API is described as supporting automation and reporting, which implies programmatic export. However, the evidence never states that the logs record who connected to which machine and when, and no audit-log or API docs could be retrieved (the probes returned 404s). missing for 10: documented connection-level log fields (user, machine, timestamp), an explicit export format or UI export, public API documentation for audit logs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit

citations.quote: Full audit logs via Teams API
